units.source_text: 他们围坐在火盆旁边烤手，谈论很多话题，

en.t: They sat around the brazier warming their hands and talked about many things,

units.source_text: 包括俊吉的小说创作，共同认识的朋友，

en.t: including Shunkichi's fiction writing and friends they both knew,

units.source_text: 还有东京和大阪的不同等等，似乎有聊不完的话。

en.t: as well as the differences between Tokyo and Osaka, and it seemed there was no end to what they could talk about.

units.source_text: 可是，他们两人好像商量好一样，

en.t: But the two of them seemed to have agreed in advance,

units.source_text: 完全不谈家庭开支方面的任何话题，

en.t: and did not mention anything at all about household expenses,

units.source_text: 这让信子深刻的干说道，她是在和表兄聊天。

en.t: which made Nobuko feel deeply that she was talking with her cousin.
